newsitem.title: CHINA: China forms post-handover Hong Kong office.
newsitem.headline: China forms post-handover Hong Kong office.

text.p: China said on Thursday it had formed a foreign ministry team for Hong Kong after Britain hands back the colony on July 1, but declined to say who would lead it.
Hong Kong newspapers have tipped China's Ambassador to Britain Jiang Enzhu to head the office, handling foreign affairs matters entrusted to it by the Beijing central government..
"The Foreign Ministry's office in Hong Kong has been formed," ministry spokesman Shen Guofang told a news briefing.
"As to who will head the office, we will announce this at an appropriate time," Shen said. He gave no further details.
With some autonomy, Hong Kong reverts to Chinese rule under a 1984 Sino-British accord that ends more than 150 years of colonial rule.
